intent: Build a multi-part user-management feature spanning password reset, role assignment, audit log access, and bulk import.

ambiguities.question: Which of the four implied stories should RTIA draft in full for this run?

implied_stories.title: Self-service password reset
implied_stories.summary: An end user can request a password reset via email without contacting support.

implied_stories.title: Admin assigns role to user
implied_stories.summary: An administrator can assign or revoke a named role on any user account.

implied_stories.title: Admin views user audit log
implied_stories.summary: An administrator can review every authentication and permission change for a chosen user.

implied_stories.title: Bulk user import from CSV
implied_stories.summary: An administrator can upload a CSV to create or update many users in one operation.
